outcome: cord gas analysis of umbilical vessels
cohort: 60 obese (BMI > 30 kg/m2) low-risk pregnant women and 108 age-, ethnicity-, and parity-matched nonobese pregnant control subjects.
finding: Maternal obesity was not found to significantly influence the fetal electrocardiogram during labor as an independent risk factor for adverse pregnancy outcomes, and no infant in either group developed definitive metabolic acidosis.
